description: Configure the URL Warpweb POSTs to whenever a form is submitted on this site. Each delivery is signed with HMAC-SHA256 (header `X-Warpweb-Signature` over the raw request body) using a site-scoped secret.  IMPORTANT: the signing secret is returned in `secret_issued` ONLY on the first configure or when `rotate_secret: true` is passed — store it immediately, it is not retrievable later. Re-configuring with the same URL is idempotent (no new secret issued).  Before this is configured, form submissions deliver as plain email to the site's contact email instead. Most API customers want the webhook path for structured JSON + verification.  Free to configure; free to deliver.

rotate_secret.description: When true, regenerates the signing secret (invalidates the prior one). Default false.

siteId.description: Site UUID to configure the form webhook for.

webhook_url.description: Your HTTP(S) endpoint that will receive form-submission POSTs.

name: configure_form_webhook
title: Configure where a site sends form submissions
